scope_note: This is one relation inside Freud's 1923 structural model; it is not a neuroscientific localization or a validated developmental mechanism.
statement: In Freud's 1923 structural model, the ego was the part of the id modified through the perceptual system by the external world.
statement_zh: 在 Freud 1923 年的結構模型中，自我是本我經由知覺系統受外界影響而改變的部分。
